title: Gel Electrophoresis Protocol
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yvxfw7n
materials: Cap the bottle and mix by swirling
Allow gel to set for approximately 00:20:00 .

steps.title: Prepare 1× TAE Buffer
steps.instruction: In a large glass bottle add 750 mL deionized water, then add 15 mL 50× TAE buffer to make 1× TAE.

steps.title: Add Agarose to Buffer
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate amount of agarose powder for the desired gel concentration to the 1× TAE solution, then swirl gently to mix without creating bubbles.

steps.title: Transfer Buffer for Heating
steps.instruction: Pour 300 mL of the agarose‑containing TAE solution into a microwavable glass bottle.

steps.title: Microwave Agarose Solution
steps.instruction: Microwave the bottle in 40‑second intervals, swirling the bottle between intervals, until the agarose is completely dissolved.

steps.title: Cast Gel
steps.instruction: Pour the molten agarose solution into the gel mold with the well insert, filling to the black line (approximately 100 mL).

steps.title: Place Gel in Electrophoresis Chamber
steps.instruction: Transfer the gel boat containing the solidified gel into the electrophoresis chamber.

steps.title: Add Running Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1× TAE buffer to the chamber up to the line marked on the chamber, ensuring the gel is completely covered.

steps.title: Load Samples and Ladder
steps.instruction: Carefully load each well with the green ladder and amplification product (1–5 µL). Optionally, mix 1 µL loading dye with 4 µL product in a separate microcentrifuge tube before loading.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Close the chamber lid, turn on the power supply, press ‘RUN’, and run for 50 minutes. The power supply does not shut off automatically; set a timer and turn it off after 00:50:00.

steps.title: Transfer Gel to Staining Tray
steps.instruction: Move the gel from the chamber into the staining tray.

steps.title: Adjust Staining Buffer Level
steps.instruction: Check the buffer level in the staining tray and add more buffer if necessary.

steps.title: Add Ethidium Bromide
steps.instruction: Add 8 µL ethidium bromide to the staining tray.

steps.title: Stain Gel
steps.instruction: Turn on the staining stage and allow the gel to stain for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Image Gel
steps.instruction: Place the stained gel in the imaging machine, turn on the machine using the left‑side switch, press ‘Trans UV’, and capture an image with the camera.
